---
title: "Module 2: 'I want to fix my delays, and see what works before I try it'"
subtitle: "2F: Bringing your simulations to life with vidigi"
author:
    name: Sammi Rosser
# Title slides (title-slide.html / title-slide.scss): a splash slide with just
# the logos, then the title slide itself. Every key is optional.
splash:
  logos:
    - image: "assets/nihr_logo_trimmed.png"
      alt: "NIHR logo"
      position: top-centre # top-/bottom- + left/centre/right; omit for the centred row
      height: "56px"
    - image: "assets/hsma_logo_tall_tagline_trimmed.png"
      alt: "HSMA logo - Learn, Apply, Implement"
      position: bottom-centre
      height: "600px"
tagline: "We're Animaniacs!"
partner-logo: "assets/nihr_logo_trimmed.png"
partner-logo-alt: "NIHR logo"
partner-logo-plate: none # the NIHR logo is white - it vanishes on the default white plate
title-video:
  youtube: "AExH1e6SvZA" # the ID after `watch?v=` - an unlisted video works fine
  autoplay: true
  muted: true
  loop: true
  no-controls: true # no player controls/hover overlay, no click-to-pause; YouTube shows its thumbnail for ~3.5s to hide its start-up overlay
qr-code: auto # QR code to the hosted deck: `auto` (from the git remote) or a URL, e.g. "https://..."
qr-code-caption: "Get the slides"
title-box-image:
  # placeholder: true # dashed "Image goes here" box - replace with `image:` (+ `alt:`)
  image: "assets/animaniacs-yakko-wakko-dot.webp"
  # alt: "Description of the image"
title-audio:
  src: "https://github.com/hsma-programme/hsma_assets/raw/refs/heads/main/h6_theme.mp3"
  loop: false
title-countdown: true # top-left timer, starting when this slide is reached: true = 10 minutes, or e.g. 5 / 2.5 / "5:30"
title-media-a:
  image: "assets/hsma_logo.png"
  alt: "HSMA logo"
  bare: true # no shadow box behind the transparent logo
  position: right # under the NIHR logo; omit for top-left
format:
  live-revealjs:
    output-file: index.html # ensures picked up by github hosting
    # Title-slide wiring lives here rather than in the shared _metadata.yml so
    # it only applies to this deck -- slides_nhs_oa.qmd keeps the stock title
    # slide. Quarto adds these list entries to _metadata.yml's own.
    theme: [title-slide.scss]
    template-partials:
      - title-slide.html
    include-after-body:
      - file: resources/countdown.html # title-slide countdown timer (`title-countdown:`)
      - file: resources/youtube-autoplay.html # starts the title video when the deck is loaded straight onto it
# The output *directory* (docs/) is set at the project level in _quarto.yml,
# not here -- a per-document output-dir key looks like it should work but
# Quarto silently ignores it for this project type, which is why docs/ went
# stale after the section restructuring. See _quarto-nhs_oa.yml for how a
# second deck gets its own output-dir via a project profile instead.
# Shared format/execute/filters/plugins config lives in _metadata.yml --
# Quarto merges it in automatically for every document in the project,
# including sections rendered/previewed standalone. Keeping it out of here
# avoids two copies of that config drifting apart.
---
